facts.statement: SBI VISA Crypto Card points can be automatically and fee-free converted to a selected BTC, ETH or XRP reward; VCTRADE account required.

SBI's BIZ card extends the crypto-rewards card to corporate/organization representatives and sole proprietors; business bank account payment is allowed, but the applicant is a representative/sole proprietor.
SBI START bond is a ¥10B security-token bond using ibet for Fin and offers XRP rewards; reward amounts and sourcing are not disclosed.
SBI shareholder benefit and a historical SBI Shinsei Bank deposit campaign provide XRP exchange coupons; these are incentive distributions, not evidence of market purchases.
SBI VC Trade lists RLUSD, but its own terms explicitly support Ethereum chain only; the service does not accept XRPL RLUSD deposits/withdrawals.
SBI Circle Japan is a 50/50 JV; SBI separately disclosed a $50M strategic equity investment in Circle and participation in Arc token presale.
Circle Arc mainnet names SBI Group as a founding validator, Coinbase as an exchange-access partner and Morpho as a credit-layer participant; USDC is native gas.
Circle's supported-chain documentation lists XRPL for USDC; this is separate from SBI VCTRADE's Ethereum-only RLUSD support.

SBI and Startale joined Open Standard with 140+ members including Coinbase and are considering a JPYSC/OUSD interoperability PoC; this is consortium membership and PoC intent, not a direct bilateral contract.
SBI/Startale/BlackRock signed an MOU to explore tokenized MMF and JPYSC; SBI/SMFG announced a separate capital/business partnership to explore stablecoin services.

SBI's JPYSC is issued by SBI Shinsei Trust and distributed by SBI VC Trade; initial circulation is restricted to VCTRADE accounts without external-wallet withdrawal pending legal/tax and supervisory conditions.
SBI's Bitbank transaction is a signed agreement to acquire 100%, conditional on regulatory clearance and other conditions; official completion was not found by cutoff.
Tokyo SBIC East Japan is Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd.; the 1963 law identifies Tokyo, Nagoya and Osaka sister companies. It is not SBI Holdings.
A 1B XRP escrow release is scheduled to become finishable at 2026-11-01 00:00 UTC across two escrow objects; historical re-escrow does not establish a sale.

Binance's 12-hour initial PoR snapshot target (07:33 UTC Oct31) had elapsed by this cutoff; no completed snapshot surfaced in the current official-channel search. Results were stated to be due by Nov2.
Current TradRadar panel is provider-scoped; Oct30 ETF flows are partial in CryptoKeyhole while Alpha's displayed series ends Oct29. These series must remain separate.
Main is c779b26; 184 PRs are open, 174 drafts, 10 ready; 181 of 182 main-based PRs have stale base SHAs. #1411 is the only current-base PR.

claims.claim: Binance has allocated >$6.34B in company funds and plans to acquire the remaining ~$1.34B of affected token assets through market/OTC channels.
XRP Insights reports ~31.4B XRP in 98 escrow objects and a 1B scheduled release at Nov1 00:00 UTC.
TradRadar reports ~$1.85B XRP OI and 78.5% long-account share.
CryptoKeyhole reports partial Oct30 ETF outflow of ~$866K from two of four funds.

inferences.statement: SBI is pursuing a multi-rail strategy spanning XRP distribution, USDC/RLUSD/JPYSC, Circle Arc, Open Standard/OUSD, tokenized MMFs, Solana and trust/custody consolidation; it is not an exclusive XRP strategy.

SBI's card, shareholder and bond rewards create XRP distribution channels, but their actual conversion volumes and inventory-versus-market sourcing are unknown; they cannot yet be counted as net spot demand.

Circle Arc is a separate stablecoin-native network that could compete with some XRPL settlement/credit use cases while complementing multi-chain liquidity; no XRP-native Arc gas or XRP-specific Arc collateral role is established.
The planned Bitbank acquisition could materially expand SBI's Japanese exchange distribution/custody scale if completed, but current consolidation must not be assumed.
The Nov1 1B escrow event is a scheduled release opportunity, not a sell order; actual EscrowFinish, re-escrow, destination and exchange disposition must be observed.

disconfirming_evidence.finding: VCTRADE RLUSD is Ethereum-only; the SBI listing is not an XRPL RLUSD distribution route.
Arc's native gas is USDC, not XRP; Arc is a separate network from XRPL.
SBI/Startale and Coinbase share Open Standard membership, but the release describes a multi-party consortium and a contemplated PoC, not a direct bilateral Coinbase-SBI contract.
SBI's Bitbank acquisition is conditional and official completion was not found; prior 'completed Oct1' wording is superseded.
Card points, coupons and bond rewards do not disclose whether XRP is acquired on spot markets.
A scheduled escrow unlock does not establish an EscrowFinish transaction, sale or exchange inflow.
Binance's aggregate $1.34B planned acquisition does not disclose an XRP-specific purchase amount.
Tokyo SBIC East Japan is a separate policy-implementation company under its own statute; the shared letters do not establish affiliation with SBI Holdings.
Circle's API support for USDC on XRPL does not imply SBI VCTRADE uses XRPL for its RLUSD service.
ETF provider coverage and derivatives OI contract universes differ; values must not be averaged or interpreted as complete capital flows.
